args.subject: Group booking inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am inquiring about group booking availability for 10 people at City Hub Tokyo in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Availability for a group of 10 guests during June 2024
- Room options and rates for group bookings
- The booking process and any required deposits
- Cancellation policies for group reservations

I would appreciate a prompt response as we are planning our stay soon.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
